frames.text: A woman with short dark brown bob haircut stands centered in frame, facing the camera directly. She wears a loose-fitting cream/beige V-neck blouse with short sleeves, dark blue skinny jeans, and black high heels. Behind her is a rustic stone fireplace with a wooden mantel, set against beige walls. The room has dark hardwood flooring and recessed ceiling lights provide warm, even illumination. The composition is a full-body portrait shot in vertical/portrait orientation.

The same woman remains in nearly identical position, standing straight with arms relaxed at her sides. Her expression appears neutral with a slight smile. The stone fireplace with its layered brown and gray stones remains prominently visible behind her. The lighting continues to be warm and well-balanced from the recessed ceiling fixtures. The camera framing is consistent, showing her full body from head to toe in the center of the frame against the living room backdrop.

The woman maintains her centered standing position with minimal movement from previous frames. The camera angle appears slightly adjusted, revealing more of the room including a doorway visible on the left side. The stone fireplace hearth and its gray stone base are more visible. Her posture remains upright and composed, with the same cream blouse, dark jeans, and black heels. The warm interior lighting and hardwood floors create a cozy residential atmosphere.
